feed.headline: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
feed.ai: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

feed.headline: The EU that Burnham is eyeing up is very different to the one Britain left
feed.ai: Andy Burnham wants "steps" towards a closer EU alignment. But the bloc has changed considerably since the UK left it

feed.headline: Who to watch in Spain's election race
feed.ai: Spain votes on 29 November, with the conservatives leading most polls after eight years of Socialist-led rule.

feed.headline: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
feed.ai: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

feed.headline: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
feed.ai: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

feed.headline: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

feed.headline: ECB President Christine Lagarde on Why She’s Stepping Down Early
feed.ai: The president of the European Central Bank said she wanted to use her voice and decades of experience against what she said was “fake news” and “misrepresentations” in European elections.

feed.headline: The Shadow of Yalta Hangs Over Trump’s Summit in China
feed.ai: A 1945 meeting of Churchill, Stalin and Franklin Roosevelt set Europe’s course for decades. Here’s what happened.

feed.headline: Europe Is Racing to Make Air Defenses ‘Cheaper Than What We Are Shooting Down’
feed.ai: Defense companies are facing calls to increase production, cut costs and keep pace with rapidly evolving technology as the Russian threat intensifies.

feed.headline: Putin Will Continue Ukraine War Despite Plans to Meet Trump, Intelligence Says
feed.ai: President Trump plans to discuss Ukraine with the leaders of Russia and China. He has halted some sanctions on Russia and announced that the United States will buy Russian diesel.

feed.headline: Cash Hidden in Forests? Hungary Goes After Corruption Under Orban
feed.ai: The new government says $20 million worth of bank notes uncovered in farmhouses and woods are the “tip of the iceberg.” Allies of Viktor Orban, the former prime minister, call it a witch hunt.

feed.headline: Putin Is Open to Meeting With North Korea’s Leader in China, Kremlin Says
feed.ai: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia could meet with Kim Jong-un if he travels to Shenzhen for the APEC summit this week. North Korea has not confirmed whether Mr. Kim will attend.
